name: Luckfingers

automation.text: You touch one Medium or smaller creature, suffusing it with confidence and skill. Until the spell ends, the creature has Advantage on all ability checks. If such a check results in failure, the creature can choose to end the spell and automatically succeed on the ability check.

subclasses: Occultist Monster Hunter, Sanguine Thief Rogue, Spellslinger Gunslinger, Arcane Hand Monk, Arcane Hand Monk
description: You touch one Medium or smaller creature, suffusing it with confidence and skill. Until the spell ends, the creature has Advantage on all ability checks. If such a check results in failure, the creature can choose to end the spell and automatically succeed on the ability check.
higherlevels: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3rd. If a creature chooses to end the spell to automatically succeed on an ability check, the spell ends only for them.
